summary: Tested Promotions/Discount engine end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass — GET /api/promotions returns merged defaults (brunch+evening_snack), PUT /api/admin/promotions persists discount_pct/start_time/end_time/regions/enabled (verified via subsequent GET), unauthenticated and bad-token PUT correctly rejected (403/401), default merge preserves combo_categories/drink_categories. promoEngine.js logic verified via Node script (9/9 cases): brunch eligibility India+Australia 11–12, evening_snack India-only 16–17, masala-name match, disabled flag honored, outside-window non-application. Frontend Table Booking: weekday date → [data-testid=type-unlimited-breakfast-disabled] visible & disabled with ₹299/$35 pricing; weekend date → [data-testid=type-unlimited-breakfast] visible, clickable, with ₹299/$35 pricing. Frontend Admin: Promotions tab reachable via [data-testid=promotions-admin-tab], renders both promo-brunch-card and promo-evening-snack-card with all fields (start_time, end_time, discount_pct, regions, combo/snack/drink/keyword); editing brunch discount_pct=13 → save → 'Promotions saved — live for customers' toast → GET /api/promotions reflects 13. Promotion config restored to documented defaults (brunch 11:00–12:00 10% [India,Australia]; evening_snack 16:00–17:00 10% [India]). Pickup page cart-promo banner UI was NOT exercised end-to-end (region/center select interaction stalled before menu load), but the underlying evaluator and APIs that drive it are 100% covered by Node + pytest tests.
action_items: Optional: add explicit DELETE /api/admin/locations/{id} (carry-over from iteration_12, unchanged).
Optional: dismiss/suppress the global 'Welcome to Purnabramha' auth modal on /admin route — currently bypassed via JS in tests; real users have to manually close it before logging in.
Optional: add data-testid='pickup-add-{item_id}' on Pickup menu item Add buttons so cart-level promo flow can be exercised by Playwright (currently no add-* testids exist on Pickup page menu items).
critical_code_review_comments: promoEngine.js correctly uses local browser time and short-circuits when promotions object is absent — defensive and correct.
DEFAULT_PROMOTIONS merge strategy in PUT /api/admin/promotions ({**default, **body[key]}) is correct: missing keys retain defaults; sent keys override. ✅
GET /api/promotions also merges per-key with defaults — guarantees forward-compat when defaults add new fields.

evaluatePromotion ordering: brunch checked before evening_snack — fine since their windows don't overlap (11–12 vs 16–17), but if an admin sets overlapping windows the brunch wins; documenting this priority would help.

TableBooking isWeekendBooking: parses bookingDate as local midnight via `T00:00:00` — good (no UTC drift). When bookingDate is empty, the enabled card is shown as a hint with 'Select a Sat/Sun date to enable' — UX-friendly.
evening_snack tea_keyword match uses .name only (not category) — intentional per spec ('items with masala in name'), but a Masala Tea item miscategorized won't be missed since it's a name match. ✅
Pickup menu Add buttons lack data-testid (no add-* testids found in DOM) — blocks automated cart-flow regression tests.

success_rate.frontend: Admin Promotions tab + Table Booking weekend gating 100% verified; Pickup cart UI not exercised due to missing menu-item testids (logic verified at engine level)

seed_data_creation: None. Promotion config was temporarily mutated during tests (brunch discount_pct → 13, brunch window widened to 00:00–23:59) and explicitly restored to documented defaults at end of every test (final state verified: brunch 11:00–12:00 10% [India,Australia], evening_snack 16:00–17:00 10% [India]).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_promotions.py -v to regress the promotions API. Run `node /app/backend/tests/test_promo_engine.mjs` to regress the discount evaluator. The Pickup page does not expose data-testid on menu Add buttons, which is why end-to-end cart promo flow cannot be automated yet — ask main agent to add `data-testid=pickup-add-{item.id}` (or similar) on the Add buttons inside Pickup.js menu cards, then a Playwright test can: (1) PUT widen brunch window to 00:00–23:59, (2) select India/HSR, (3) click add on a Heavy Brunch item + a Tea & Coffee item, (4) assert [data-testid=promo-applied] visible, (5) restore defaults. The Admin /admin route still has the Welcome auth modal overlay carry-over from iteration_12 — bypassed in tests via document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]').forEach(d=>d.style.display='none').
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All requested promotion features behave correctly end-to-end across backend, evaluator, Admin UI, and Table Booking weekend gating.
